We’re on a family plan with my father in law and I’m positive I could order and iPhone Duo and he wouldn’t notice. I don’t think he has access to his email right now (forgot password) and most of his mail goes to a house he doesn’t live in anymore. He wouldn’t open the mail anyway.

So iPhone 18 Pro Max it is then… I really wanted to like the iPhone Duo but for some reason it just isn’t calling to me.

I’m glad the price hikes weren’t as severe as the rumour mill was suggesting.

Look, I love my Pixel, so this event wasn't geared towards me, but I genuinely thought the iPhone Duo looked impressive and sleek. 

But starting at $2k for only 256GB is CRAZY. 

👀👀👀
Honestly, this. I'd love to try the form factor of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 or iPhone Duo, but without the folding bits
